dimensionScores.evidence: ListObjectsV2Command sends Prefix `${environment}/segments/` and Delimiter '/'; keys come only from response.CommonPrefixes via keyFromCommonPrefix, which requires startsWith(prefix) and endsWith('/'), slices off both and drops anything failing validateSegmentKey, so no '/' or env name survives; keys accumulate in a Set and return sorted. Tests assert the exact request input and that a foreign-environment prefix, a slash-less prefix, an undefined Prefix and 'Not A Key' are all dropped.

do/while continues while IsTruncated===true and NextContinuationToken is defined; the follow-up command rebuilds the same Bucket/Prefix/Delimiter and only adds ContinuationToken. A three-page test asserts the ContinuationToken sequence [undefined,'page-2','page-3'] and identical Prefix on all three, with no fixed iteration count; a further test proves termination when IsTruncated is true but no token is returned.

Verified by running the suites: empty prefix -> [] with no throw; a denied listing throws REQUEST_FAILED with key 'production/segments/' rather than an empty list, and the adapter maps it to unavailable; a malformed pointer yields unavailable with no rejection reaching the caller. The adapter's only catch returns unavailable, never []; an absent pointer (readPointer -> null) is distinguished and omitted, proven by the test that still lists gamma when beta's pointer is missing.

Each key maps through readPointer and the row is built inside toPublishedSegment(pointer), so version and memberAttribute come from that key's own pointer, not an outer loop variable; memberAttribute is spread conditionally so an absent one stays absent with no default. The beta v3/accountId + gamma v7/no-attribute test confirms per-row versions. createS3SegmentLister and its two types are exported from packages/aws/src/index.ts and pinned by the exhaustive export-surface test.
